posts.text:
The best kind of winning doesn’t diminish others.
It dignifies them.
It reaches back, lifts up, and reminds us that greatness shared is greatness multiplied.

Video

Donald Trump is corrupt and does not care about law and order. He cares about personal profits and grifting and grabbing off of his office.

Video

The war in Iran is slamming our family farmers right as planting season hits. One-third of the world’s fertilizer moves through those waters — now shortages and skyrocketing prices threaten our food supply.

Video

Trump & Vance’s leadership continues to fail us.

We deserve better than this.

Video

ICE is reckless and out of control.

Her family says she was unlawfully detained by ICE for 5 months.
No crime. No reason. 

This cruelty must stop.

Video

Our national security experts have made it clear: Trump’s war in Iran has not resolved the fundamental issues that sparked this conflict.  

Trump’s reckless warmongering must stop.

Video

Thank you, Boss, for standing up for the soul of America, in these challenging times. 

No retreat. No surrender.

Video

Here’s to breaking cycles - 
to proving our past is not our destiny.

Here’s to healing.
To growth.
To redemption.

To turning wounds into wisdom
and trials into triumph.

And here’s to giving our children
what we all deserved: 
roots to ground them,
and wings to let them soar.

Video

Welcome home Artemis, so many incredible moments for science and exploration, but it was truly a showcase of the best in all of us.

Video

Honored to stand with @TheRevAl and the entire National Action Network family as we celebrate 35 powerful years of justice and organizing.

Video

This World Parkinson’s Day, I want to extend my gratitude to organizations like The Micheal J. Fox Foundation. 

This foundation was a source of solace and invaluable resource for me and my family as we supported my father through Parkinson’s disease.

I am inspired by the tireless effort of the foundation in finding breakthrough treatments, solutions and important support for patients in their everyday lives.

Video

Great to join @TheRevAl and the National Action Network today. Energized by their fight and their spirit!

Video

This really touched me.
Don’t rush past the moment
be in it.
Savor it.
Honor it.
Love the people in it.
Because time plays tricks on us 
the minutes feel long…
but the years disappear.
So open your heart and your eyes.
See the beauty in broken places.
Find the light in the shadows.
See the perfection in imperfection
the wonder in the ordinary.
Anchor yourself in something deeper than time.
Know this:
Moments may pass…
but love can endure.

Video

One small act. One big ripple.

We are the heroes we are looking for.

Video

Instead of pouring billions into a reckless war with Iran, we should be investing in childcare, paid leave, and lifting up our working families.

OP: keds_economist

Video

Pope Leo lifted his voice for peace and the vulnerable — and the president threatens the Vatican in response?

This is not who we are.

OP: underthedesknews

Video

Start your day right: take a moment to remember all the goodness that exists in the world. 

OP: thedadbriefs

Video
